race.comment: DO A LITTLE DANCE (7) brings the most appealing profile, with his Sunshine Coast sixth looking better than the bare result after he began awkwardly and laid in when tackling provincial company. He had been close at Toowoomba the run prior when favourite, and fourth-up in a maiden of this depth gives him a strong chance to convert. ANY NEWS (5) is the main danger after a Mareeba second as favourite, with the tightening near the 700m adding merit and his repeated placings around 950m keeping him very relevant. DEE THREE (6) resumes from a five-month spell with two placings from two tries at this trip, while his 2yo Open form last campaign reads well enough. FOXY CHEVAL (11) has been honest with consecutive thirds and gets weight relief plus an apprentice claim, though her record at 950m keeps her more in the place mix than a clear top pick. VINCENTVANGEE (2) is another that resumes and is worth keeping safe after a close trial.
